grand_strategy.reading:
Azerbaijan runs the strategy of a state that won its central war and is
now converting a position of force into a durable order without a patron.
The 2023 recovery of Karabakh and the exodus of about 100,000 Armenians
closed the territorial question on the ground; what remains is to make
the settlement legal (the Armenian constitution, the treaty, TRIPP) and
to keep the rents that pay for it while oil declines. The method is
multi-vector balancing: a treaty alliance with Turkey, arms and oil with
Israel, jets from Pakistan, a charter with Washington, gas to Europe,
transit with China and Central Asia, and a managed truce with Russia
after the AZAL crisis. Luttwak's pattern shows in each: every success
attracts the counter-pressure that limits it. The Israeli link brought
Iranian drones, the American corridor puts Washington on Azerbaijan's
border with Armenia, the argument won against Moscow ended in a
settlement without punishment, and a regime that jails journalists is
trading the European Parliament for the European Commission. Two
signals that are not rows: Aliyev skipped the Moscow Victory Day
parade in May 2025, and in 2026 the contacts with Russia reported to
us run through a deputy prime minister and foreign ministers, with no
head-of-state meeting found; and the peace is still a text initialled
but unsigned while Azerbaijani fuel and Russian grain already cross
the old front line. The test of the next year is whether Baku lets
Armenia reach the referendum on its own terms or keeps raising the price of signing.

stances.note: Until 2023 the pair were mortal enemies (the ontology's reference case for 'adversary'). Since the Karabakh offensive of 19-20 Sep 2023 and the exodus of about 100,000 Armenians, Baku's aim is no longer Armenia's defeat but a settlement on its terms: the treaty was initialled in Washington on 8 Aug 2025, transit restrictions were lifted on 21 Oct 2025 and fuel exports to Armenia run at USD 17.6m in January-August 2026. Still not a partner: the constitution is a precondition for signing, 'Western Azerbaijan' is in official use, Armenian churches are being demolished and the Karabakh leaders were sentenced in February 2026 (Vardanyan 20 years). Warming because of the Washington text, the transit and the June 2026 Armenian election, which left Civil Contract short of a constitutional majority.
